content.text: Explore the gorgeous Dawki island while in Shillong is one of the nicest things you can do. Dawki Island has a lot to offer in terms of activities and exploration. Dawki camping is one such pastime that all travellers and those who appreciate experiencing unspoiled nature will enjoy. The camps are located directly adjacent to the cleanest Shnongpdeng River. Private Camping in Dawki will provide you with the opportunity to experience nature's wildness. Book this beautiful riverside private camping adventure with your loved ones and enjoy the experience.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Enjoy a serene yet unique private camping experience on the banks of the cleanest Shnongpdeng River
Go boating on the Shnongpdeng River and explore the neighbouring beautiful green nature

main.title: Private Camping at Dawki, Shnongpdeng Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival and Camping
items: The clean riverbank of the Shnongpdeng river is ideal for pitching your luxury private tent.
Have fun relaxing in your tent and enjoying the cool river breeze.
In the evening, enjoy a fun-filled campfire and a great chit-chat session with your friends or family.
By sitting inside your tent, you can see the lovely sparkling stars.
Sleep in the comfy tents along the picturesque Shnongpdeng river.

days.title: Day 2 : Activities and Departure
items: Get up early in the morning to get sights of such lovely sceneries.
You may hear the singing of birds and the flowing waves of the river as you wake up.
Enjoy a delicious breakfast before heading off for an exciting adventure activity/check-out from the campground.
Check out of your campsite in Shnongpdeng and head to your hometown with this wonderful camping tour.

items.text: Kayaking is a sport that involves manoeuvring a kayak over water. It can be a fun way to get exercise and see the sights. Kayaking in Shnongpdeng is a great way to explore the area. The water is calm and clear, making it easy to see the surroundings.The scenery is beautiful, and the kayakers can explore various waterways. The 20 minute experience would be your best adventurous moment on an inflatable kayak.
Kayaking will individually cost 500/- per person.

Cliff jumping is an adventurous activity, where adventurers jump into the river with no equipment, only with a life jackets. It is an activity in which an individual jumps from a hill or slope of 20-30 meters in height.
Cliff Jumping will individually cost 500/-per person.

Swimming with a snorkel on the water surface allows the snorkeler to see underwater sights through a scuba mask and tube. Snorkelling in Dawki is a thrilling experience that is perfect for people who are energetic. It is also a great way to see some of the beautiful coral reefs that are located in this area.It's no wonder that snorkeling in Dawki, Shnongpdeng, is such a popular activity for adventurers. The reef here is teeming with colorful fish, and the surrounding coral is beautiful and soft to touch.
Snorkelling will individually cost a 500/-per person.

Scuba diving is a sport or activity that involves swimming underwater while wearing an air tank and a specific breathing system strapped to your body. Diving in Dawki, Shnongpdeng is a unique experience because the river water is so clear. It's perfect for scuba diving because the visibility is perfect and there are plenty of opportunities to see interesting wildlife. Underwater diving using a self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) allows a diver to breathe underwater without needing any surface air supplies.
Scuba Diving will individually cost 3200/-per person.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Private Camping at Dawki, Shnongpdeng

items.question: 1. What is the cheapest price for a riverside private camping package in Dawki Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: The cheapest price for private riverside camping in Shnongpdeng starts at Rs. 2,100/- per person which includes tent and bedding.

items.question: 2. Are meals and breakfast available at the campsite Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: Yes, dinner and breakfast is included in our camping package and it is served to you at the campsite. We also offer a tasty budget-priced camping package with the option of ordering the food in advance. We serve Asian meals and breakfast. Our meals include Rice, Dal, Potato Fry, Salad, Chutney etc. For breakfast, there are Maggi or bread with eggs.

items.question: 3. Does the campsite provide bedding, blankets and pillows during Dawki Tent Stay?

answer.text: Yes, bedding, blankets and pillows are provided during your riverside camping and is included in the Dawki Tent Price of Rs.2,100/-.

items.question: 4. Does the campsite have a bonfire or campfire arrangement during the stay?

answer.text: Yes, a bonfire is arranged for guests who opt for the private Camping Package or higher packages.

items.question: 5. Is Dawki Shnongpdeng Camping a riverside camping or a beach camping?

answer.text: Yes, it is riverside camping or beach camping.

items.question: 6. Does the campsite provide lights inside the tents during camping at Dawki River?

answer.text: Yes, rechargeable light is arranged inside the tents during overnight camping.

items.question: 7. Does the campsite have a parking facility?

answer.text: Yes, parking space is available outside the Shnongpdeng Campsite where two-wheelers and four-wheelers can be parked.

items.question: 8. Are luggage rooms available during the Dawki Tent Stay?

answer.text: You can keep your luggage inside the tents, however, if there is any valuable item, you can keep it with the campsite owner.

items.question: 9. Is private camping available in Dawki, Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: Yes, you can book private camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng with at the best price of @2100/-. Camping will be done in a private campsite near the river in spacious alpine tents.
